description: Every HTML table on a public web page as structured JSON: title (caption or nearest heading), headers, rows as arrays and as records keyed by header, numeric columns detected and parsed to numbers, colspan and rowspan expanded, footnote markers removed. Selecting one table by index also returns it as CSV. Row count capped by max_rows. Price: $0.003 USDC per call (x402).

index.description: Zero-based table index; when given only that table is returned, with csv

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the page
